sense: the skeleton a house type is built on
definition: The volumetric skeleton of a house type — its footprint, storeys, bays, roof and how it grows without breaking. It is independent of style: a foursquare can be dressed Craftsman, Colonial Revival or Prairie.
basis: schema/massing.schema.json: "A style-independent volumetric skeleton." and "an American Foursquare massing can be dressed Craftsman, Colonial Revival, or Prairie"; its fields carry the footprint, stories, bays and default roof, and its expansion logic is "How the type grows without breaking." VISION.md: massings are among the "Three catalogues that every style draws from and none owns."
